manifest_row.title: Intrepid scientists witness final days of Venezuelan glacier

screening.main_topic: Scientists documenting the disappearance of Venezuela’s last glacier and studying the climate and ecological changes it brings, despite the country’s political and economic crisis.
screening.climate_relevance: The article directly discusses human-caused warming, rapid glacier retreat in the tropical Andes, regional water dependence, and ecological succession after ice loss.
screening.reason: Climate change and its impacts are central to the report: scientists are monitoring the glacier as it vanishes, and the article explains the causes and consequences of its retreat.
